# Dentist Tiers

Dentist tier guidance composes three layers:

1. general premium visual discipline from [Design](../../../Design/linker_Design.md)
2. dentist-specific register from [Dentist Register](../register.md) and [Dentist Typography](../typography.md)
3. project-specific commercial tier decisions from the current project's brand docs

This folder exists because some dentist preview projects have commercial tiers. It does not make "Tier 3" a universal Astro design concept.

## Available Tier Notes

- [Tier 3](tier_3.md): premium dentist-preview routing note. Use when a dentist project explicitly identifies a page as Tier 3 / Partner / premium preview work.

## Boundary

Do not duplicate the full general Design rulebook here. Do not store exact colors, font families, feature matrices, page counts, or package pricing here.

Commercial feature matrices stay in project docs. Exact brand values stay in project docs and token files.
